issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueBackground: Reflected cross-site scripting arises when data is copied from a request into the response without sanitization. This maps to CWE-79.
issue.issueDetail: The value of the q request parameter is copied into the HTML response without encoding.
issue.remediationBackground: HTML-encode all user input on output. Validate input where possible.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: • CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

issue.name: TLS certificate (Heartbleed vulnerable)
issue.issueBackground: The server is affected by the OpenSSL Heartbleed vulnerability CVE-2014-0160. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N applies.
issue.issueDetail: A crafted TLS heartbeat request leaks memory contents.
issue.remediationBackground: Upgrade OpenSSL to a patched version and rotate keys.

issue.name: Information disclosure (server banner)
issue.issueBackground: The Server response header reveals software version details.
